column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Mammon's Evil Deity armor
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Damn it! To think I'd have to use that against poor wretches like you!
W-what? A suit of the $$大邪神$$'s armor?!
And someone is already wearing it!
Hey, old man, that's not what you told us!!
Can just anyone wear that armor?!
To wear a suit of the $$大邪神$$'s armor, one must first tear off one's own $$羽$$...
And to wield its power, one must, like this fellow, show the power of the $$大邪神$$...
there was no one like that!!
Those two bodies will probably not get away unscathed!!
Heh heh heh. If something that small could defeat them, it would make things easier for me too!
(Even if $$マモン$$ is killed, I should be able to learn the strength of a battle between $$邪神$$ armors!!)
Well then, give it your very best!
